q: How long until I get my refund after you receive my return?
answer: Refunds go to your original payment method within 7 business days of us receiving your return.

q: Can I return the swimsuit I bought? It's still in the packaging.
answer:
I'm sorry, but swimwear can't be returned — even if it's still in the packaging. That's part of our Final Sale policy.

If you'd like, I can connect you with a human agent for anything further.

q: Can I return a gift card?
answer: No — gift cards can't be returned. Anything else I can help with?

q: The zipper on my jacket broke after two months. What can I do?
answer:
I'm sorry to hear that! Since it's a defective item, you can report it within 90 days of delivery with a photo, and we'll cover the shipping. You can choose either a refund or a replacement.

Would you like help starting that?

q: Who pays shipping on a defective item?
answer: We cover the shipping for defective or damaged items. Just report it within 90 days of delivery with a photo, and you can choose a refund or a replacement.

q: I want to exchange for a different color but it's out of stock. What happens?
answer: If the color you want is out of stock, we'll refund you instead. You can start the exchange in the returns portal.

q: I got this as a gift and have no gift receipt, only the order number. What do I get back?
answer: You'll get store credit for the price paid. Just start the return in the returns portal with the order number.

q: I bought online. Can I return it in a store, and how long do I have?
answer: Yes — online purchases can be returned at any Alder & Co. store within 45 days of delivery. Just make sure the items are unworn, unwashed, and have the tags attached.

q: I'm ordering from Canada. How long do I have to return, and do I get duties back?
answer: For international orders, you have 14 days from delivery to return. The customer pays return shipping, and duties and taxes are not refunded.

q: My order shipped 12 days ago and hasn't arrived.

Could you share your order number so I can get this started?

- In the meantime, is the coat within 45 days of delivery, unworn with tags attached, and not Final Sale? That'll help speed things up.

Let me connect you with a human agent for the refund.

answer: I'm so sorry to hear that — I hope your hand is okay. Injuries must go to a human agent, so I'm escalating this right away. Please contact our support team directly so they can help you.

answer:
Since it’s been worn, it doesn’t meet our return condition (items must be unworn, unwashed, and have tags attached), so it wouldn’t be eligible for a standard return.

If you think it arrived defective or damaged, you can report that within 90 days of delivery with a photo, and we’ll cover shipping and offer a refund or replacement.

q: How many days do I have to return an item?
answer: You have 45 days from delivery to return an item. It must be unworn, unwashed, and have the tags attached.

q: An item I bought 10 days ago just dropped in price. Can I get a price adjustment?
answer: Yes — if it’s within 14 days of purchase, you can get a one-time price adjustment. Just note it’s not available on Final Sale items or purchases made with promo codes.

q: The price dropped after I used a promo code on it. Can I get an adjustment?
answer: I don't have that information — price adjustments aren't available on purchases made with promo codes, but I can't confirm anything beyond that. Would you like me to connect you with a human agent?

q: Do you price match Amazon?
answer: I don't have that information. Our policy covers price adjustments for items that drop in price on our own site within 14 days of purchase, but it doesn't mention price matching other retailers. I'd be happy to connect you with a human agent for that.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't have that information. For questions about discounts, please reach out to a human agent.

q: Can I return something I bought six months ago?
answer: Our return window is 45 days from delivery, so an item bought six months ago would be outside that window. I don't have information on returns beyond that timeframe—would you like me to connect you with a human agent?

q: Do I pay a shipping fee to return in a store?

q: How long does an exchange take to arrive?

q: Can I get store credit instead of a refund to my card?
answer: Our policy only covers store credit for gift returns (with a gift receipt or order number). For regular returns, refunds go to the original payment method. I don't have information on choosing store credit otherwise—would you like me to connect you with a human agent?
